cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Only six people cracked our supper-club invitation. Excellent: a more selective table. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Five thought it was a puzzle night. They've cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Wonderful. We've filtered out everyone who wasn't committed to dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The last one's the printer asking to be paid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An invitation-only dinner with our sole supplier. It's become a private partnership event.

mechanism: A manages a supper table and handles cancellations/payment while treating every lost guest as proof of a more selective and exclusive event.
confusable: Unlike merely coping with low attendance, A celebrates it as improved design; authority keeps B participating through concrete hosting tasks and shared work.
comparison: Guest attrition into a supplier meeting differs from camouflage for a proposal picnic.
seedUse: D140-b six responses, five puzzle cancellations and printer bill; S02-b changes hosting work around B corrective facts.
